events.name: Downtown First Friday – Giving Thanks & Giving Back
events.description: The last Downtown First Friday of the season, themed Giving Thanks & Giving Back, on Beale Street.

events.name: Route 66 UltraRun
events.description: An ultramarathon along historic Route 66 between Kingman and Seligman, listed among Kingman's signature annual events.

events.name: Kingman Veterans Day Parade
events.description: Kingman's Veterans Day parade down Beale Street in historic downtown, organized with the Kingman Area Veterans Association.

events.name: Gobble Wobble in the Pai's 5K/10K
events.description: Hualapai Mountain Park's 3rd annual Gobble Wobble trail race with 5K and 10K options. Race-day registration closes at 8:30am.

events.name: Chillin' on Beale
events.description: Downtown Kingman's monthly third-Saturday street gathering on Beale Street, in its final month of the season.

events.name: Radar Hill Tree Lighting
events.place: Heritage Complex, 701 N Stockton Hill Rd
events.description: Kingman Chamber of Commerce and Kingman Premier Properties light the Radar Hill tree. Kids' games, food trucks, free hot cocoa and cookies, and holiday singing. Park off Johnson Ave and Hall St behind Walgreens.

events.name: Mingle Jingle Christmas Bazaar
events.description: A free bazaar of handmade gifts in fabric, wood, ceramic and glass, plus jewelry, candles, jams, baked goods and quilts. Santa visits from 1 to 4pm for photos.

events.name: Very Merry Street of Lights
events.description: Six blocks of Beale Street fill with dozens of decorated floats and vehicles, vendors, lights and entertainment. Santa arrives by helicopter at 1st and Beale at 5pm, and the city's tree lighting is at Locomotive Park at 6pm. Walking event only.

events.name: Downtown Cookie Crawl
events.place: Historic Downtown Kingman (Chamber, 309 E Beale St)
events.note: Check the Chamber for ticket details.
events.description: Grab a cookie container and stroll downtown, collecting holiday cookies from participating businesses. Hosted by the Kingman Area Chamber of Commerce.
